subject: Delay on the vendor comparison draft
text: Good morning, I wanted to let you know that, as the classmate handling the vendor comparison, I need more time on the table. I completed the pricing and delivery sections, but I still need to confirm two service terms. The suppliers were slower than expected, and I do not want to guess. I expect to finish by end of day. I can share the updated draft tonight for your review. I am sorry for the short notice. Please let me know if you need a partial version earlier, and I will prepare it quickly.
